business_summary: Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, trading, and sale of gold products in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Mining Products and Trading and Wholesale segments. It is also involved in the trading of mining products and non-ferrous metal; and wholesale and trading of frozen meat and agricultural products. The company was formerly known as China Billion Resources Limited and changed its name to Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited in November 2021. Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 금 제품의 탐사, 채굴, 거래 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 광업 제품, 무역 및 도매 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 또한 광산 제품 및 비철금속 거래에도 참여하고 있습니다. 냉동육류 및 농산물의 도매 및 거래. 이 회사는 이전에 China Billion Resources Limited로 알려졌으며 2021년 11월에 Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Renaissance Asia Silk Road Group Limited는 2000년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
